# Version 3.119.3
> **Servicing preview update** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.3-preview.1.1)

> **Superseded by [3.119.4](3.119.4.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.119.4.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.3 preview fixes Linux ARM64 and Ahead-of-Time deployment failures. It also refreshes bundled image and text dependencies and hardens native assets.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux ARM64 and AOT startup failures fixed** — Linux ARM64 packages include the required fontconfig runtime library, and AOT applications work when reflection is disabled. ([#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494), [#3485](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3485))

## Security

- **Bundled dependencies and native protections refreshed** — Updates libpng, libwebp, brotli, and native binary hardening settings. — ❤️ [@sshumakov](https://github.com/sshumakov) ([#3452](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3452), [#3478](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3478), [#3469](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3469), [#3496](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3496), [#3502](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3502))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.4

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
